# Data Source: tfe_registry_providers

Gets public and private providers from the private registry of an organization.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as constructs from "constructs";
import * as cdktf from "cdktf";
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import * as tfe from "./.gen/providers/tfe";
class MyConvertedCode extends cdktf.TerraformStack {
  constructor(scope: constructs.Construct, name: string) {
    super(scope, name);
    new tfe.dataTfeRegistryProviders.DataTfeRegistryProviders(this, "all", {
      organization: "my-org-name",
    });
  }
}

```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.
- `registryName` (String) Whether to list only public or private providers. Must be either `public` or `private`.
- `search` (String) A query string to do a fuzzy search on provider name and namespace.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the organization.
- `providers` (Attributes List) List of providers in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `createdAt` (String) The time when the provider was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the provider.
- `name` (String) Name of the provider.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the provider. For private providers this is the same as the organization.
- `organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `registryName` (String) Whether this is a publicly maintained provider or private. Will be either `public` or `private`.
- `updatedAt` (String) The time when the provider was last updated.
